newsitem.title: USA: Zytec sees Q2 earnings above views.
newsitem.headline: Zytec sees Q2 earnings above views.

text.p: Zytec Corp said Thursday its second quarter earnings are expected to range from $0.39 to $0.41 per share.
The company said this exceeds analysts' average estimate of $0.31 per share by about 30 percent, and compares with earnings of $0.22 per share (adjusted) in the 1996 second quarter.

Second quarter sales are expected to be slightly higher than estimates of about $69 million, the company said. In early May Zytec said it expected second quarter sales to be about 20 percent higher than the first quarter's $57.6 million.
Zytec expects to report second quarter results on July 22.
